account.title: Login & security
account.subtitle: Protect your account with two-step verification and review where you're signed in.

login.title: Two-step verification
login.body: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.recovery_body: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-step verification. Each code works once.
login.token_expired: Your sign-in took too long. Please enter your number and log in again.
login.invalid_code: That code is incorrect. Check your authenticator app and try again.
login.invalid_recovery: That recovery code is incorrect or has already been used.

legal.title: Please review our updated terms
legal.body: To keep using KaamSathi, read and accept the documents below.
legal.accept_one: I have read and accept the {kind}
legal.check_all: Tick each document to accept it.
legal.outdated: These documents were updated a moment ago. Reload the page to see the latest version.

mfa_required.title: Two-step verification is required
mfa_required.body: Your ops role requires two-step verification. Set it up to continue using the ops console.

role_guard.title: Not available for your role
role_guard.body: This page is for super admins. Ask a super admin if you need access.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.description: After your SMS code, also enter a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy…).
mfa.enabled_body: Two-step verification is on. You'll be asked for a code from your authenticator app when you log in.
mfa.disabled_body: Add a second step to your login so a stolen SMS code alone can't open your account.
mfa.step_scan: 1. Scan this QR code with your authenticator app
mfa.qr_alt: QR code for setting up your authenticator app
mfa.qr_failed: The QR code couldn't be loaded. Use the setup key instead.
mfa.step_manual: Can't scan? Enter this setup key
mfa.step_code: 2. Enter the 6-digit code from the app
mfa.code_invalid: That code is incorrect. Check the time on your phone and try the newest code.
mfa.codes_body: If you lose your phone, each code lets you log in once. They will not be shown again.
mfa.codes_ack: I have saved these codes somewhere safe
mfa.codes_file_note: Each code can be used once. Keep this file private.
mfa.disable_body: Enter a current code from your authenticator app to confirm.
mfa.disable_required_warning: Your role requires two-step verification. If you turn it off, the ops console will stay locked until you set it up again.

sessions.title: Where you're signed in
sessions.description: Sign out of any device you don't recognise.
sessions.revoke_body: That device will need to log in again with an SMS code.
sessions.revoke_others_body: You'll stay signed in here. Every other phone and browser will need to log in again.
sessions.revoked_others_toast: {count, plural, =0 {No other devices were signed in} one {Signed out # device} other {Signed out # devices}}

role_desc.verifier: Workers, identity & credential checks, employers, work history, mobility; jobs, organizations, crews, training.
role_desc.support: Disputes, support cases, privacy requests; jobs, organizations, crews, training.
role_desc.superadmin: Everything, including staff, audit trail, taxonomy and system health.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.subtitle: Append-only, hash-chained record of sensitive actions.
audit.verify_ok_body: {count, plural, one {# entry checked} other {# entries checked}} — no tampering found.
audit.verify_broken_body: The chain breaks at entry {id} (after checking {count}). Escalate this immediately.

staff.title: Staff & roles
staff.subtitle: Who can use the ops console, what each person can open, and their two-step verification status.
staff.count: {count, plural, one {# staff member} other {# staff members}}
staff.add_body: Creates the account, or gives ops access to an existing user with this number.
staff.edit_body: Roles decide which ops pages this person can open. Super admin includes everything.
staff.self_superadmin_warning: You're removing your own super admin role. You'll lose access to this page.
staff.reset_mfa_body: {name}'s authenticator and recovery codes will stop working. They'll have to set up two-step verification again. Only do this after confirming their identity.
staff.activate_body: {name} will be able to log in again with their current roles.
staff.deactivate_body: {name} will be signed out and won't be able to log in.

system.title: System health
system.subtitle: Live status of the database, cache, background workers and scheduler, plus failed background tasks.
